homeCollection.heading: Diagnostics at Your
homeCollection.subtext: Skip the queue. Our certified phlebotomists come to your home at a time that works for you — especially ideal for elderly patients, busy families, and post-surgical care.

steps.title: Book Online
steps.description: Choose your tests and select a convenient time slot through our website or phone.

steps.title: We Come to You
steps.description: Our certified phlebotomist arrives at your door, equipped with sterile collection kits.

steps.title: Reports Online
steps.description: Receive your digitally verified report via WhatsApp, email, or our secure portal.
